name: The Olive
shortDescription: Beachside condominium near Naiyang Beach with 29 indoor and outdoor facilities.
description:
Two residential buildings and one facilities building of up to eight storeys, 450 m from Naiyang Beach and about 5 minutes from Phuket airport.
287 residential units plus 4 shops. Outdoor facilities include a lap pool, kids pool, pet park and yoga lawn; indoor facilities include steam and sauna, fitness, co-working and a kids club.
